title: Exactly Three Red Balloons
tests: Whether the final illustration satisfies an exact object count, colour constraint, and clear separation.

judge.summary: The square image shows exactly three separated red balloons, each with its own dangling string, against a pale blue sky with no text.

must_haves.item: Exactly three balloons are visible, with no extra balloons in the background.
must_haves.why: There are three balloons and no additional balloons visible.
Each balloon has a clearly red body.

must_haves.item: The balloon bodies are separated and individually countable.
must_haves.why: The three balloon bodies have ample space between them and do not overlap.

must_haves.item: Each balloon has its own visible dangling string.
must_haves.why: A separate light-colored string hangs beneath each balloon.

must_haves.item: The illustration has a pale blue sky background, a square frame, and no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, has a pale blue sky background, and contains no visible text.
